title: LogiQA: A Challenge Dataset for Machine Reading Comprehension with Logical Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting ablation experiments by removing partial information (such as the paragraph or the question) to check if models can guess the correct answer relying on dataset artifacts rather than full reasoning.

Calculating the unigram overlap between candidate answers and the given paragraph to evaluate if models exhibit a bias toward selecting answers based on superficial surface matching instead of logical inference.
